description: Create a new ad creative with object_story_spec. The spec defines the ad content (link, photo, or video) and the associated Facebook Page. Notes for v26.0: poll_spec and the poll type under interactive_components_spec are no longer supported and will be rejected. If the advertiser has a shop, eligible creatives now default to destination_spec.destination_type=WEBSITE_AND_SHOP — set it to WEBSITE_AND_SHOP_OPT_OUT to opt out.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to create the creative in (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

asset_feed_spec.description: JSON string of asset_feed_spec for dynamic creative

degrees_of_freedom_spec.description: JSON object for Advantage+ creative controls, including creative_features_spec.image_animation, video_filtering, and video_uncrop

destination_spec.description: JSON object controlling the destination; set destination_type=WEBSITE_AND_SHOP_OPT_OUT to opt out of the v26 Shops default

object_story_spec.description: JSON string of object_story_spec (page_id, link_data/photo_data/video_data). Use the separate wamo_whatsapp_identity_spec parameter for WhatsApp Status ads.

url_tags.description: URL tags to append to all links

wamo_whatsapp_identity_spec.description: JSON object with wamo_whatsapp_identity_id or whatsapp_phone_number for WhatsApp Status ads; sent at the creative's top level

name: create_creative
